brief.scope: Rule on five red regression tests. Read in/failures-ladder-inputs-tests-20260910.md and in/brief-ladder-inputs-tests-20260910.md WHOLE; the brief's quoted contract paragraphs are the only requirements. For each of the five failing tests in ops/conductor/tests/test_ladder_lever_inputs.py, decide UPHELD, REJECTED or PARTIAL against the fix in ops/conductor/tools/ladder.py, citing the contract sentence, and report each as a finding with a reproduce command. Read-only; edit nothing.

findings.claim: REJECTED — The test requires dry-run launch argv to expose the plan and start inputs in after-plan order. The contract says only, “Each `--input PATH` names a file handed to every stage beside the scope and plan”; it does not specify dry-run output or argv ordering. The fixture stub omits every input from its dry-run `launch_argv`, causing this failure independently of the fix.
findings.reproduce: TMPDIR=/dev/shm python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/conductor/tests -p test_ladder_lever_inputs.py -k test_dry_run_argv_carries_input_after_the_plan

findings.claim: UPHELD — A bare `--input` refuses with expected text `--input followed by a path`, rather than naming the documented form. This violates: “Refusal `arguments` names the form `SCOPE BRANCH [PLAN] [--input PATH]... or resume LADDER_ID`.”
findings.reproduce: TMPDIR=/dev/shm python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/conductor/tests -p test_ladder_lever_inputs.py -k test_input_flag_without_a_path_refuses_arguments

findings.claim: UPHELD — A missing input reports needed `supply a input`. This violates: “Refusal `input`: a `--input` path is absent or unreadable; needed "supply a readable input file".”
findings.reproduce: TMPDIR=/dev/shm python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/conductor/tests -p test_ladder_lever_inputs.py -k test_missing_input_refuses_input

findings.claim: UPHELD — An unreadable input reports needed `correct its permissions`. This violates: “Refusal `input`: a `--input` path is absent or unreadable; needed "supply a readable input file".”
findings.reproduce: TMPDIR=/dev/shm python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/conductor/tests -p test_ladder_lever_inputs.py -k test_unreadable_input_refuses_input

findings.claim: REJECTED — The failing assertion requires a clean fixture worktree before resume, which the quoted contract does not require. `close_tripped_record` rewrites a tracked dispatch record without committing it, so the test fails at line 346 before invoking resume. The applicable contract sentence is: “Resume: a recorded input whose bytes changed refuses class `record`, "restore the recorded bytes or repair the digest", before any dispatch.” The fix implements that check at ladder.py:1605 and ladder.py:377; committing the fixture’s rewritten dispatch record makes the test pass.
findings.reproduce: TMPDIR=/dev/shm python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/conductor/tests -p test_ladder_lever_inputs.py -k test_resume_refuses_when_input_bytes_changed

envelope.note: All five failing tests were ruled against the quoted contract only: 3 UPHELD, 2 REJECTED, 0 PARTIAL. The tracked tree remained clean.
